name: Instant dice: the Bandit Captain fells its first target mid-Multiattack
source: Bandit Captain: System Reference Document 5.2.1 by Wizards of the Coast, CC-BY-4.0 (2026-10-21: was the SRD 5.1 Captain). TEST SETTING: its attack bonus is raised to +25 so every attack hits. Test characters otherwise.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bandit makes two attacks, using Scimitar and Pistol in any combination.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Pistol
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage.
